choices.content: Only their moduli need to be equal
Only their real parts need to be considered
It is sufficient for the absolute values of their imaginary parts to be equal
Their real parts must be equal and their imaginary parts must be equal

question.prompt: For two complex numbers to be equal, what is required?

solutions.explanation: The real and imaginary parts in algebraic form are unique, so both parts must be equal.
solutions.title: Uniqueness of algebraic form
